lines.story/intro: Hi! This is practice for an AI-powered voice interview, not one with a real person. I'll ask a question out loud. Answer when you're ready, then press “Done answering”. Each question has a follow-up. Saying “I'm not sure” is allowed. I don't judge your answers: you check them against key points.
lines.story/about-own-part: In the work you just described, what did you do yourself?
lines.story/fit: Why do you think you're a good fit for this role?
lines.story/fit-gap: Which part of the role is newest to you, and how would you learn it?
lines.story/proof: Tell me about something you did that made a difference.
lines.story/proof-how: How did you know it worked?
